architectureVerification.outerInstallerStub: PE32 executable (GUI) Intel 80386 (stripped to external PDB), Nullsoft Installer self-extracting archive - a standard 32-bit NSIS bootstrapper; this is normal NSIS behavior on Windows and does NOT mean the installed application is 32-bit
architectureVerification.installedApplicationBinary: cip-desktop.exe: PE32+ executable (GUI) x86-64 (stripped to external PDB), confirmed via `file` against target/x86_64-pc-windows-gnu/release/cip-desktop.exe - the actual application that runs after installation is genuinely x64
architectureVerification.method: file(1) run directly against both the installer and the embedded application binary in this build environment

provenance.builtDuring: Phase 3.6 (Church Knowledge Libraries & Service History) - rebuilt to package the new Bible/Music/History library screens, saved_scriptures migration, and the verse-range presentation fix
provenance.buildEnvironment: cross-compiled from Linux using rustup target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu, gcc-mingw-w64, and nsis (makensis) - identical toolchain to Phase 3.4/3.5/3.5.1, see docs/phase-3-4-windows-pilot.md for the original toolchain setup and docs/phase-3-6-church-libraries.md for what changed this phase
provenance.note: This artifact supersedes the Phase 3.5.1 installer (previously SHA-256 9d59e0c7236c4a0aaa4995d66aeda9631ea119f66145e103805e5baf8c58f664) because this phase added one additive database migration (0010_saved_scriptures.sql), three new Tauri commands (list_bible_books, save_scripture/list_saved_scriptures/delete_saved_scripture, list_presentation_history), a verse-range presentation bug fix, and three new frontend library screens. This is a freshly compiled build (`cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` via `tauri build`), not a copy of a prior artifact.

releaseCandidateStatement: This is the Phase 3.6 SOFTWARE RELEASE CANDIDATE for Windows x64 (Church Knowledge Libraries & Service History). It is a real, verifiable build artifact - not a placeholder, not a simulation, not a fabrication. See docs/phase-3-6-church-libraries.md for the full PROVEN/PARTIAL/NOT AVAILABLE/NOT VERIFIED breakdown and final gate (GO WITH CONDITIONS).
physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. This installer has not been installed, launched, or tested on any real Windows machine, including the target HP EliteBook 830 G6. No real microphone, no real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, and no real operator workflow has been exercised against the new Bible/Music/History library screens. Xvfb, simulated audio, virtual displays, automated tests, and cross-compilation success are Environment A/B evidence only and are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation.
githubReleaseStatus: NOT CONFIGURED - no .github/workflows directory exists in this repository, and no GitHub Release has been created for this artifact. This installer is available only via this repository's working tree (release/windows/), not via GitHub Releases or any CI/CD pipeline.
obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there. Running the installer on Windows requires none of: Claude Code, Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, or the CIP source tree - only the .exe file itself.
